mutations.name: a PR with no changed path counts as covered
kills: a CI-policy plan approval's cover never covers a PR with no changed path

mutations.name: the reviewer's weakened keys are not checked against the approved keys
kills: a CI-policy plan approval's cover does not cover a weakened key the owner was not told about

mutations.name: one pinned changed path covers the whole PR
kills: a CI-policy plan approval's cover does not cover a rename whose source is not pinned as absent

mutations.name: a changed path missing from the head blobs reads as absent at head
kills: a CI-policy plan approval's cover does not cover when the head blobs miss a changed path, even one pinned as absent

mutations.name: every pinned path must also be changed
kills: a CI-policy plan approval's cover ignores a pinned path the PR leaves unchanged
